mapper.sql: r.id, r.employee_id, r.place_id, r.qrcode_id, r.checkin_type, r.checkin_time, r.source, r.result, r.lng, r.lat, r.client_ip, r.request_id, r.remark, r.created_at

, e.emp_no AS empNo, e.name AS employeeName, d.dept_name AS deptName, p.place_name AS placeName, CASE r.result WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN '正常' WHEN 'LATE' THEN '迟到' WHEN 'EARLY' THEN '早退' WHEN 'ABNORMAL' THEN '异常' ELSE r.result END AS resultText, CASE r.checkin_type WHEN 'ON_DUTY' THEN '上班' WHEN 'OFF_DUTY' THEN '下班' WHEN 'FIELD' THEN '外勤' ELSE r.checkin_type END AS checkinTypeText

where.if: AND (e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.emp_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO att_record (employee_id, place_id, qrcode_id, checkin_type, checkin_time, source, result, lng, lat, client_ip, request_id, remark) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{placeId}, #{qrcodeId}, #{checkinType}, #{checkinTime}, #{source}, #{result}, #{lng}, #{lat}, #{clientIp}, #{requestId}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM att_record WHERE request_id = #{requestId}

SELECT
FROM att_record r LEFT JOIN hr_employee e ON e.id = r.employee_id LEFT JOIN org_department d ON d.id = e.dept_id LEFT JOIN biz_place p ON p.id = r.place_id WHERE r.request_id = #{requestId}
